contents_summary: One supplement id with two files. A Word document (inf-42-1-s001.docx) holds Supplemental Digital Content 1 to 10: the PubMed search string, a table of contributing publications, a country-of-origin table, group-level characteristic tables by income group (all nosocomial and community-acquired deaths, LMICs, UMICs, HICs), a sensitivity-analysis table, a forest-plot figure of odds ratios (embedded image) and a native Word clustered column chart of the age-band distribution with an embedded workbook. A PDF (inf-42-1-s002.pdf, 8 pages) lists the RSV GOLD study group collaborators and their affiliations. All content is registry-level, literature-level or administrative; no individual patient is described.

review.contents: Embedded image 1: forest plot of odds ratios with 95% confidence intervals for fourteen characteristics in four colour-coded country groups (Supplemental Digital Content 5).
review.clinical_relevance_notes: Group-level comparison plot of registry characteristics; no individual patient and no printed numeric values.
limitations: No printed rights notice on the image; article source license retained without blanket relicensing.
No numeric values are printed on the plot, so nothing is transcribed.

visual.general_description: Forest plot of odds ratios with 95% intervals for fourteen characteristics in four colour-coded country groups.
visual.detailed_description: Horizontal forest plot on a white background with light grey grid lines. The y axis is titled "Characteristic" and lists fourteen row labels from top to bottom: Female, Neonatal death, <3 months at death, <6 months at death, Year of death < 2015, Comorbidity, Prematurity, Birth weight < 3kg, Not exclusively breastfed, Hospital stay at least 7 days, ICU admission, ICU stay at least 7 days, Mechanical ventilation, Mechanical ventilation at least 7 days. The x axis is a logarithmic scale with printed ticks 0.010, 0.100, 1.000, 10.000 and 100.000, titled "OR for presence of characteristic (nosocomial relative to community-acquired) with 95% CI". A black dashed vertical line is drawn at the 1.000 tick. Each row has four thick horizontal interval bars, each with a black dot, in four colours: green, blue, orange and grey; the legend titled "Countries" at right names green "all", blue "LMIC", orange "UMIC" and grey "HIC". Bar lengths differ widely between rows and colours, and some bars cross the dashed line while others lie to one side of it. No numeric values are printed beside the bars.

limitations: All 284 extracted text units of the Word document were read; units marked non-literal by the extractor (4, 6, 10 to 21, 24 to 26, 28, 265 to 284) are not quotable, and no clinical facts are transcribed from this supplement.

The Word document embeds a workbook (word/embeddings/Microsoft_Excel-werkblad.xlsx, sheets "3A", "3B" and "leeftijdsverdeling health+comor") behind the native age-band chart; it is aggregate only, its group sizes 28/76/120 (total 224) differ from the article's LMIC/UMIC/HIC 32/76/123, and it sits outside the extraction inventory, so it was not reviewed as a spreadsheet.
The collaborator list in the PDF contains personal names and affiliations that are not transcribed.
No individual patient is identified anywhere in the supplement; group counts are not assigned to patients.
